feature: Customer Portal v2 -- COPILOT READINESS (/portal-v2/copilot). The assessment verdict page and, since the rebuilt Overview has no Copilot gate band, the ONLY surface for the Copilot gate anywhere in the portal. WIRED TO LIVE DATA (Git #1213): every figure and the tenant name come from the real Copilot assessment engine via useCopilotJourney() -> JourneyView -- pillar scores, findings, the gate score and the tenant name are all real and tenant-specific. It used to render copilotData.ts's hardcoded fixture (six literal before/after scores, a '41 -> 68' gate, and the prototype's fictional 'Halden Materials' tenant name shown to every real customer). None of that survives.
notes: Git #1443: the 'What the assessment produced' card used to render CP_DELIVERABLES -- a hardcoded 5-item list under invented 'DOC-01'..'DOC-08' numbers -- next to a fixed 'Nine documents, all issued' note, even though the list only ever showed five. The card now renders the tenant's real document set off view.generation (withLiveDocuments/generationView, the same source RevealFullPicture/Scene 9 renders from), and the note is the real, computed generationView() note. CP19-CP21 assert the real set and the real note; the old fixture would fail both.
THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute.
UI ROUTE SHAPE: /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/copilot. App.tsx declares '/portal-v2/copilot' ABOVE the '/portal-v2/:pillar' insertion marker so the param route does not swallow it.

shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- the #1213 live-data rewrite asserts green only after the pushed commit is deployed. Against the OLD deployed build the fixture assertions (Halden Materials etc.) would still pass and the live ones (pv2-cp-source = 'live') would fail; that is the expected pre-deploy signal, not a regression.

THE GATE DENOMINATOR IS THE CONSTANT, NOT A LITERAL. CP2 asserts 'of 82', which the page renders from COPILOT_GATE_TARGET (journeyTokens.ts) via copilotModel's gateDenominatorLabel() -- never a hardcoded 82. The constant is mirrored server-side in copilot-gate.ts and each side is asserted by its own test; copilotModel.test.ts is the client half.

LIVE, TENANT-SPECIFIC NUMBERS ARE NOT ASSERTED BY VALUE. The gate score, verdict and per-pillar scores depend on the tenant's own scan, so the harness asserts STRUCTURE and the honest-source marker rather than a specific number: pv2-cp-source = 'live' proves a real numeric score is on screen (not a fixture, not the unscored/loading state), the verdict is asserted any-of ('not safe to deploy' | 'safe to deploy'), and the pillar rows are proven by their STATIC advisory copy (the why/fix lines, which are tenant-agnostic guidance).
THERE IS NO NEGATIVE TEXT ASSERTION IN THIS HARNESS, and an array in `textContains` is ANY-of, not all-of. Every all-of assertion here is its own step.
NO `select` STEPS. UiTestExecutor.cs cannot drive a native <select>; this page has none.

THE ADD-ON / BOOKING BUTTONS open flows not built this pass and are visual. The six 'Open <pillar>' buttons and the document links point at routes that genuinely exist (the pillar pages and /portal-v2/documents).
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

SCOPE CONFIRMED (Git #1465) -- this page is NOT one of the six /portal-v2/:pillar dashboards (Governance/Security/Compliance/Licensing/Adoption/Health). It is the separate, dedicated Copilot readiness / standalone-offer verdict page at the plain route /portal-v2/copilot, driven by useCopilotJourney()/JourneyView (copilot-journey/*), not usePortalV2Pillars. Copilot's SCORE does ride along as the 7th slot in the same WAR_ROOM_PILLAR_KEYS/pillars payload the Overview's gate card reads (see portal-v2-pillars.json's A3/A5) -- that is a shared data source, not this page's own render path; this page's own numbers all come from the copilot-journey engine, same as the four Copilot Readiness screens. No fixture leaks found on re-check: Halden Materials / CP_DELIVERABLES are gone (confirmed by grep, only referenced in comments describing what USED to render), consistent with the #1443 fix already landed (commit 1ef235915, now on main).

STALE PIN, NOT RE-CONFIRMED LIVE THIS SESSION (Git #1465) -- lastVerifiedAgainstCommit was left at 03d1b2ca even after commit 1ef235915 extended this same file with CP19-CP21 (the #1443 fix); that commit's own log says those steps were reachable but reported 'no steps matched session tag' because the fix was not yet deployed. 1ef235915 is now on main, so CP19-CP21 should be re-run for real, but shaneapp://runTest was not reachable this session (shane-msp MCP server failed to connect, CONNECTION_CLOSED) -- a genuine tool blocker, not a skipped step.
